summary: Updates RFC 4055 with new conventions for the parameters of the RSAES-OAEP and RSASSA-PSS algorithms in X.509 certificates. It clarifies how parameters should be encoded. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Some locks need small settings written on them. This update fixes the way those settings are written down in certificates, so everyone reads them the same way.

questions: what changed for rsa-oaep and rsa-pss parameters
